AnyBattery.Description: A Battery Pack you place and stretch like a fuel tank: 4 kWh at the smallest size, more as you stretch it. It starts empty, so charge it from an alternator or solar panels; the charge is saved with each world. Found in loot after the first bunker. Standalone mod, not part of a bundle. Anymaker 0.1.27 only.

AnyLights.Description: One paint tool for every colour: right-click any paint tool for the full palette and Fill, Flood, Brush, Pencil and erase modes, with Ctrl+Z undo. Headlights, beacon, bar and siren lights glow the colour you paint them. Standalone mod, not part of a bundle. Anymaker 0.1.27 only.
